xm3.uses: XM3's config.json, common.mjs, table.mjs storedRows and lib/ffm.mjs imported unchanged at the commit (git diff --quiet): the groups, period, scoring, fit, environment, conditions and bootstrap; through them XM's code at 2c7b326 and the wasm pinned at modules 9a05d899b

weather.rows: XM's lib/weather.mjs rowsM through XM3's lib/ffm.mjs driverRows: observed F10.7, daily Ap and the true centered 81-day mean of F10.7; a day through D0 + 8 with no row takes the last row at or before it

arms.F2M: XM3's F2 with condition M's rows in the fit and the forecast: run here
arms.F2O: XM3's F2 under condition O: XM3's stored rows, read only; the sample rerun to equality first
arms.P: XM3's P: XM3's stored rows, read only; the same sample
arms.F2H: F2M with the 3-hourly ap history: not run, it needs a module change

guard.rule: every M row against XM3's row and XM's stored M row; a difference is a software defect and stops the run

sample.filled: compared on the days propagator/ffm reads, D0 - 4 through D0 + 8 (XM3's amendment 1)

C4.role: must equal XM3's committed cell in every number

closes.cell: C1's upper bound of the p95 ratio

worst.rule: the ceil(0.05 n) windows of largest e; a failure is largest; ties by key

check.rule: each window rerun and compared exactly, under M with the stored row and under O with XM3's; the table rebuilt equal to the committed table.json

integrity: XM3's cuts, unchanged: C2's time cut and held-out objects, ISS out, no laser spheres, GPCV P0's truth span. Never read: C2's held-out row files, B2 part 1a and part 5 files, census results, operator-capture content, C3-small's rows
